result.title: VGGT-Bridge: Beyond Sequential Pose Graphs via Coarse-Stride Skip Edges
result.summary: Feed-forward visual geometry transformers such as VGGT reconstruct dense 3D structure from images in a single forward pass, simplifying multi-view 3D reconstruction. However, their quadratic attention complexity makes them difficult to scale to long sequences with thousands of frames. Chunk-and-align frameworks address this by splitting a long sequence into overlapping chunks and stitching their local reconstructions into a pose graph. Yet existing methods connect only sequentially adjacent chunks, so small per-frame errors accumulate along the chain into large-scale drift. To move beyond sequential edges, we propose VGGT-Bridge, which adds long-range skip edges that directly constrain non-adjacent chunks without retraining. By running VGGT on sparsely sampled coarse chunks, each coarse chunk bridges distant fine chunks into a single direct constraint. We further turn VGGT's first-frame scale bias into a drift correction by feeding selected coarse chunks in reverse, and a loop-aware policy keeps this reversal compatible with existing loop closures. VGGT-Bridge reduces ATE by 28.3% on KITTI Odometry, 18.8% on Virtual KITTI, and 10.0% on Waymo Open over the SwiftVGGT baseline, achieving the best performance among all chunk-and-align methods.

AI.brief_summary: VGGT-Bridge 针对 VGGT 类前馈视觉几何 Transformer 在长序列重建中的二次注意力瓶颈，提出在 chunk-and-align 框架中加入跨块的远距离 skip 边，用稀疏采样的粗粒度 chunk 直接约束非相邻细粒度块，并利用首帧尺度偏置做反向漂移校正，从而减少长程累积漂移。
AI.relevance_reason: 虽属 3D 重建与位姿图工程，但其「用粗粒度跳连约束远端状态、抑制误差沿链累积」的思路可能与 LVR 的长程推理状态更新和误差累积控制有概念联系，可供核查。
